source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The v1.9.2 background bundle installs console wrappers that prefix the addon version and compare severity with a warn threshold. Debug, log and info call the saved log only when that threshold permits them; warn and error keep their matching saved functions. The later fixed v2.0.16 background retains that threshold. This establishes packaged background code, not the effect of Vite configuration imports, every page context or a measured logging result.
title: The packaged background logger applies a warn threshold at runtime
